audits.title: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes
audits.description: Ensure an element's role supports its ARIA attributes

audits.title: ARIA role should be appropriate for the element
audits.description: Ensure role attribute has an appropriate value for the element

audits.title: ARIA attributes must be used as specified for the element's role
audits.description: Ensure ARIA attributes are used as described in the specification of the element's role

audits.title: Deprecated ARIA roles must not be used
audits.description: Ensure elements do not use deprecated roles

audits.title: aria-hidden="true" must not be present on the document body
audits.description: Ensure aria-hidden="true" is not present on the document body.

audits.title: ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements
audits.description: Ensure aria-hidden elements are not focusable nor contain focusable elements

audits.title: Elements must only use permitted ARIA attributes
audits.description: Ensure ARIA attributes are not prohibited for an element's role

audits.title: Required ARIA attributes must be provided
audits.description: Ensure elements with ARIA roles have all required ARIA attributes

audits.title: ARIA roles used must conform to valid values
audits.description: Ensure all elements with a role attribute use a valid value

audits.title: ARIA attributes must conform to valid values
audits.description: Ensure all ARIA attributes have valid values

audits.title: ARIA attributes must conform to valid names
audits.description: Ensure attributes that begin with aria- are valid ARIA attributes

audits.title: Buttons must have discernible text
audits.description: Ensure buttons have discernible text

audits.title: Page must have means to bypass repeated blocks
audits.description: Ensure each page has at least one mechanism for a user to bypass navigation and jump straight to the content

audits.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
audits.description: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds

audits.title: Documents must have <title> element to aid in navigation
audits.description: Ensure each HTML document contains a non-empty <title> element

audits.title: IDs used in ARIA and labels must be unique
audits.description: Ensure every id attribute value used in ARIA and in labels is unique

audits.title: Headings should not be empty
audits.description: Ensure headings have discernible text

audits.title: Table header text should not be empty
audits.description: Ensure table headers have discernible text

audits.title: Heading levels should only increase by one
audits.description: Ensure the order of headings is semantically correct

audits.title: <html> element must have a lang attribute
audits.description: Ensure every HTML document has a lang attribute

audits.title: <html> element must have a valid value for the lang attribute
audits.description: Ensure the lang attribute of the <html> element has a valid value

audits.title: Images must have alternative text
audits.description: Ensure elements have alternative text or a role of none or presentation

audits.title: Alternative text of images should not be repeated as text
audits.description: Ensure image alternative is not repeated as text

audits.title: Banner landmark should not be contained in another landmark
audits.description: Ensure the banner landmark is at top level

audits.title: Contentinfo landmark should not be contained in another landmark
audits.description: Ensure the contentinfo landmark is at top level

audits.title: Main landmark should not be contained in another landmark
audits.description: Ensure the main landmark is at top level

audits.title: Document should not have more than one banner landmark
audits.description: Ensure the document has at most one banner landmark

audits.title: Document should not have more than one contentinfo landmark
audits.description: Ensure the document has at most one contentinfo landmark

audits.title: Document should not have more than one main landmark
audits.description: Ensure the document has at most one main landmark

audits.title: Document should have one main landmark
audits.description: Ensure the document has a main landmark

audits.title: Landmarks should have a unique role or role/label/title (i.e. accessible name) combination
audits.description: Ensure landmarks are unique

audits.title: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color
audits.description: Ensure links are distinguished from surrounding text in a way that does not rely on color

audits.title: Links must have discernible text
audits.description: Ensure links have discernible text

audits.title: <ul> and <ol> must only directly contain <li>, <script> or <template> elements
audits.description: Ensure that lists are structured correctly

audits.title: <li> elements must be contained in a <ul> or <ol>
audits.description: Ensure <li> elements are used semantically

audits.title: Users should be able to zoom and scale the text up to 500%
audits.description: Ensure <meta name="viewport"> can scale a significant amount

audits.title: Zooming and scaling must not be disabled
audits.description: Ensure <meta name="viewport"> does not disable text scaling and zooming

audits.title: Interactive controls must not be nested
audits.description: Ensure interactive controls are not nested as they are not always announced by screen readers or can cause focus problems for assistive technologies

audits.title: Page should contain a level-one heading
audits.description: Ensure that the page, or at least one of its frames contains a level-one heading

audits.title: All page content should be contained by landmarks
audits.description: Ensure all page content is contained by landmarks

audits.title: scope attribute should be used correctly
audits.description: Ensure the scope attribute is used correctly on tables

audits.title: Scrollable region must have keyboard access
audits.description: Ensure elements that have scrollable content are accessible by keyboard

audits.title: The skip-link target should exist and be focusable
audits.description: Ensure all skip links have a focusable target

audits.title: Elements should not have tabindex greater than zero
audits.description: Ensure tabindex attribute values are not greater than 0

audits.title: Tables should not have the same summary and caption
audits.description: Ensure the <caption> element does not contain the same text as the summary attribute

audits.title: Table cells that use the headers attribute must only refer to cells in the same table
audits.description: Ensure that each cell in a table that uses the headers attribute refers only to other cells in that table

audits.title: Table headers in a data table must refer to data cells
audits.description: Ensure that <th> elements and elements with role=columnheader/rowheader have data cells they describe
